content_sections.heading: HCI Job Description
content_sections.text: Manager (Purchase) Report to the Head of MMD/In-charge MMD, HCI. Responsible for ensuring that all required items are sourced and no wastage or stock-out situation arises as per laid out SOPs. Ensure that the items reach the user department timely as per the prescribed quality and standard. Adhere to the Company Purchase Manual, GFR (General Financial Rules), CVC Guidelines, MSE/Make in India norms and Audit readiness (Internal/Statutory /CAG). Experience in procurement of materials, preparation of purchase requisitions, vendor management, comparative statement preparation, negotiation, and purchase order management. Junior Sous Chef Reporting to the Executive Chef. Responsible for preparing the dishes as per laid-out SOPs and on a timely basis as per the day’s schedule and menu. Commis-I (Indian) Reporting to the Sous Chef. Responsible for preparing the dishes as per laid-out SOPs and on a timely basis as per the day’s schedule and menu. Commis-I (Bakery & Confectionery) Reporting to the Sous Chef. Responsible for preparing the dishes as per laid-out SOPs and on a timely basis as per the day’s schedule and menu. Associate-Engineering (AC & Refrigeration/ Electrician/ Plumber) Reporting to HOD -Maintenance. Responsible for the upkeep, routine repairs & maintenance as well as ensuring preventive maintenance of all the items installed/ placed in the hotel, including Kitchen Appliances, Air-conditioning, Plumbing, Lighting, etc.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Graduate in Engineering/ Commerce/ Business Administration, or any other relevant discipline from a recognized university/institution; minimum 06 years experience, of which minimum 5 years in Contract/Purchase/Stores/Procurement; practical GeM tendering experience. Experience required: Minimum 06 years in Government/PSU/reputed organization, of which minimum 5 years in Contract/Purchase/Stores/Procurement; practical experience of GeM tendering; experience in procurement, purchase requisitions, vendor management, comparative statements, negotiation and purchase order management. Age limit: Maximum 62 years. Pay: Rs. 65,000. Qualification required: Graduate with a certification in Food Production and minimum 4 years' experience, OR Minimum 10+2 with a certification in culinary arts and minimum 5 years' experience in food production of a major hotel chain/hotel of repute. Experience required: Minimum 4 years in hospitality industry/flight kitchen/institutional catering/cloud kitchen (graduate route) or minimum 5 years in food production department of a major chain of hotels/hotel of repute (10+2 route); knowledge of Continental, Curry & Tandoor. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Rs 47,500. Qualification required: Diploma/Graduate with a certification in Food Production and minimum 2 years experience, OR Minimum 10+2 with a certification in culinary arts and minimum 5 years experience. Experience required: Minimum 2 years in hospitality industry/flight kitchen/institutional catering/cloud kitchen, or minimum 5 years (10+2 route) in Food Production department of a major hotel chain/hotel of repute; knowledge of Continental & Indian Curry. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: Rs. 35,000. Qualification required: Diploma/Graduate with a certification in Bakery & Confectionery and minimum 2 years experience, OR Minimum 10+2 with a certification in culinary arts and minimum 5 years experience. Experience required: Minimum 2 years in hospitality industry/flight kitchen/institutional catering/cloud kitchen, or minimum 5 years (10+2 route) in Baker & Confectioner Department of a major hotel chain/hotel of repute. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: Rs. 35,000. Qualification required: Three years Diploma / ITI in AC & Refrigeration/ Electrician/ Plumber with technical or vocational schooling; basic computer skills and MS product suites; minimum 2-3 years experience. Experience required: Minimum 2-3 years in a hotel/restaurant/facility management company of repute. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: Rs. 30,000/.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fixed Term Employment Contract for 03 (Three) years, extendable by another 02 years based on annual performance Tenure can be extended or curtailed as per Company requirement Contract may be terminated without assigning reason or for unsatisfactory performance No claim for permanent absorption in the Company CTC and extension reviewed every year based on performance
